abstraction._comment: The contextual-scale dial (spec 2.2). Smartphone is the generic top rung of the three-rung demonstration ladder: smartphone (generic) -> proposed:iphone (class) -> l0:iphone-15-pro (instance). No out-edge upward: generalizes_to null. Ladder edges compiled from relation facts.

kernel._comment: Kernel admission: bucket=corroborated AND certainty>=0.7 AND no ESTIMATE:/PROXY: tag. Sweep-1 facts are all pending, so kernel is empty at this sweep. This is correct signal — the kernel is computed fresh after sweep-2 hardening. An empty kernel is not a gap; it is the honest starting state before battle-testing.
kernel.statement: PENDING HARDENING: The kernel will populate when sweep-2 verification corroborates the definitional and named facts (l0-smartphone-0001, 0003, 0006, 0007) from independent sources. Candidates: definition of smartphone as mobile computing device with mobile OS + touchscreen + app ecosystem (fact 0006, certainty 0.90); the 1997 Ericsson coinage of the one-word lowercase term (fact 0003, certainty 0.88); global category existence (facts 0009/0014).

membrane._comment: All sweep-1 facts are pending (bucket=pending, awaiting verification). Hardness h = B(bucket) x certainty, B(pending)=0.55. Proxy l0-membrane-proxy-v0.1. DISCLOSE wherever rendered.

open_questions.question: What precise year/quarter did smartphone shipments cross the threshold that could be called 'mass adoption' by a rigorous definition (e.g. >50% of all mobile phone shipments)?
open_questions.proposed_route: Fetch IDC or Gartner smartphone vs. feature-phone shipment share time series; find crossing year. Wikipedia's 'over a billion sold annually by 2014' is a scale marker, not a share marker.

open_questions.question: Does the multi-hop Turing -> universal machine -> stored-program computer -> smartphone -> Claude conceptual ancestry chain have a single citable source that attests it directly?

candidate_edge.verification_route: Search for a published historical or technical source that traces the smartphone's computational architecture explicitly to the stored-program computer and thence to the Turing machine. If none attests it directly, the edge stays a candidate.

open_questions.proposed_route: Fetch Wikipedia 'stored-program computer' and check if it links to Turing machine -> von Neumann architecture -> microprocessor -> mobile CPU -> smartphone. Each hop may be individually sourceable but the direct cross-six-sample edge needs a single attest.

open_questions.question: Is there a higher generic category label above 'smartphone' that smartphone itself instantiates? (e.g. 'mobile device', 'handheld computer') — which would add a rung above the current ladder.

candidate_edge.verification_route: Wikipedia Smartphone article calls it 'a mobile device that...' — confirming subclass-of mobile device. Fetch and cite to emit the rung-above fact.

open_questions.proposed_route: Verify from Wikipedia Smartphone article lede ('A smartphone is a mobile device...'). If confirmed, emit l0-smartphone-r0005 with predicate rel:subclass-of:mobile-device, target proposed:mobile-device, adding proposed:mobile-device to the sweep-2 frontier.

open_questions.question: Does the alan-turing wrapper's conceptual-ancestor-of edge reach smartphone? The 2018 Turing Award nodes in deep_learning.json reference 'named-after' Alan Turing; Alan Turing's work on the universal machine precedes the stored-program computer that precedes modern smartphones. Is there a source directly stating this lineage?
open_questions.proposed_route: Check deep_learning.json for 2018 Turing Award node; check if any academic history of computing source traces smartphone CPU to Turing machine model directly.

frames._estimate_note: MANDATORY DISCLOSURE: these weights are AUTHORED RENDER ESTIMATES, not measured quantities and not substrate facts. Any toy/viewer rendering them owes an adjacent estimate/proxy disclosure (UI_GUIDELINES §5). Rationale: space=0.8 (smartphone is highly spatially distributed, near-ubiquitous across all geographies); time=0.5 (the category spans ~1992-present, moderate temporal extent); knowledge=0.4 (smartphone mediates knowledge access but is not itself a knowledge-producing entity at the category level); meaning=0.5 (smartphones carry significant cultural meaning but as a generic category, meaning is moderate vs. specific models).

relations._note: iphone-15-pro is an instance of smartphone (the instance-of edge runs from iphone-15-pro to smartphone, not from smartphone to iphone-15-pro; smartphone is the target of instance-of from iphone-15-pro). The available-on edge here records the inverse membership: smartphone as the generic host platform.

Claude AI model is available on smartphones (iOS app launched 2024-05-02; Android confirmed). Transitive: claude available-on iphone-15-pro, and iphone-15-pro instance-of smartphone. The direct claude->smartphone edge is the transitive summary.

frame_layer._estimate_note: ESTIMATE: authored analytic estimate, not a substrate fact. Smartphones-as-a-category straddle: physical (instances are tangible hardware) and latent (the generic category is a semantic classification / abstraction). The physical membership is high because the prototypical smartphone is a physical object; the latent membership is significant because 'smartphone' as a concept is a definitional frame applied to devices.
